purpose: Every rendered calendar event can own one user-defined destination without changing the event's source data.

interaction.symbol_position: Top-right on every linked event, desktop and mobile.
interaction.symbol_visibility: Hidden when no destination exists; visible only after a link is saved.
interaction.class_editing: The link editor preserves access to the existing class editor through an Editar clase action.

storage.backup_behavior: Because eventLinks lives inside canonical calendar state, normal calendar export/import preserves it.

identity.rule: Prefer a stable event/source id. When no stable id exists, derive a deterministic key from source fields such as date, weekday, start, subject/title/label/rival/competition.
identity.recurring_rule: When a recurring source has a stable id, one link belongs to that recurring event identity and therefore appears on its occurrences.

destination_rules.implicit_scheme: Text without a scheme is normalized to https://

visual_invariants: The chain icon has one meaning everywhere: open the linked destination.
Do not use different link symbols by event type.
Do not move the link symbol between event types.
The link control must not consume the event title area more than necessary.
If a delete control also exists, the chain keeps top-right priority and delete shifts left.
The icon inherits the event's two-color language; UP and Boca retain their institutional exceptions.
forbidden: Hard-coding personal destinations into public source files
Opening a destination when the user clicks the event body instead of the chain
Using event links as a replacement for the event source object
Allowing javascript:, data: or vbscript: destinations
Breaking existing class editing or delete behavior
